column1: # Declared differences allowed by the merge gate for the root package (`.`).
# Reproduce (both files are versioned next to this one):
#   git archive HEAD | tar -x -C $BASE
#   codetools merge-check --base-root $BASE --head-root . \
#     --map rename-map-root.tsv --explain explain-root.tsv .   → 1 package(s) intact
# An empty explain file (must be a zero-byte file created fresh, not a reused path)
# reports 13, and removing any one row here brings that row back — so the set is both
# sufficient and minimal. A previous "minimal 3 rows" trim here was derived from a
# contaminated input (a supposedly-empty explain file that still held 10 names) and is
# reverted by that check.
# Class A — a subprocess `-run` filter string must follow the declared rename of the
# test it selects; leaving the old text makes the child match no test and pass
# vacuously (exactly what runBootChild now asserts against).
wal42Filter      # "TestWAL42_RelaunchAfterRestartResolvesOnTheCurrentFace$" follows the test rename
wal42PhaseEnv    # reuses the wal42 filter constant
wal42YamlEnv     # reuses the wal42 filter constant
wal42Child       # reuses the wal42 filter constant
mon33Filter      # "TestMonitor33_LiveSessionStaysWatchedAcrossToolGeneration$" follows the test rename
mon33Child       # reuses the mon33 filter constant
mon33Command     # reuses the mon33 filter constant
mon33PhaseEnv    # reuses the mon33 filter constant
mon33YamlEnv     # reuses the mon33 filter constant
# Class B — a fixture value named after a helper, changed only to follow the rename.
mon33SvcName     # "mon33svc" → "sessionWatchsvc": fixture text follows the helper rename
# Class C — deliberate strengthening (assertion count may only grow, body necessarily differs).
runBootChild     # added the assertion that a -run filter must match at least one test
# Class D — method text of a renamed fixture type (receiver renamed with the type).
wal42Model.Info  # receiver wal42Model → walReentryModel
mon33Model.Info  # receiver mon33Model → sessionWatchModel
